title: Smash Bros. Ultimate enters the workshop
body: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate joins the roster in development. Its server runs: DataStore queries round-trip against a real database, schemas build cleanly, and the health endpoint answers. Like every NEX title here, it has not yet faced a console — local verification first, hardware after. The plan is unchanged: prove the login path, then the data services fighters actually need, then the first console session.
